args.body: Hi, thanks for your reply. Yes, we are now sourcing a second quote for comparison for Flat 5, 55 Lantern Quay, using the same scope and check-out inspection report. The first quote (Alder Compliance, £1,370, no VAT itemised) is on hold and nothing is approved. Please note our first email attached the inspection report twice rather than the estimate, so we'll resend the estimate with the comparison. Two points to be aware of: that estimate says the bedroom carpet can stay (we asked for replacement) and includes replacing the bathroom tap (we asked for a repair). If you have a preferred contractor for the second quote, please tell us. We'll report back by Thursday 10 April.
